content: {"episode_id": "ep-05019", "cpt": "93229", "denial_carc": "CO-197", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, occurring in the context of a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack and a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction.
